programs.title: Earth: A Year In Orbit
programs.desc: A summary of key events that occurred on Earth in 2024.The authors use satellite photos to show global crises, natural phenomena and natural disasters.

programs.title: Wonders of the Human Body with Michael Mosley
programs.desc: Using the latest achievements in science and medicine, host Michael Mosley delves into the interior of the human body to discover its secrets.In each episode, he explores new discoveries that significantly change our perception.From the possibility of 3D printing organs to gene therapies promising to reverse blindness.Throughout the series, he provides additional information in his characteristic way, offering his body to perform groundbreaking demonstrations.Created by an award-winning team, the series is full of visuals and fascinating facts.

programs.title: Life Below Zero: Canada
programs.desc: The creators of the series present the everyday life of a group of daredevils struggling with wildlife in various regions of northern Canada during a frosty winter.Johnatan Granier will join the program in the second season.

programs.title: The Secret Genius of Modern Life
programs.desc: Everyday objects are prosaic companions of our everyday life and we rarely think about how they were created.However, they often hide fascinating stories.

programs.title: The World's Most Scenic Railway Journeys
programs.desc: The creators of the series go on a train journey to various places around the world.During each expedition, they meet people who live in specific areas or work on the most unique railway routes.They will also discover the wonders of nature that can be admired from the train windows.They will talk to engineers responsible for maintaining the lines and historians who will talk about the circumstances of their construction and the difficulties their builders faced.Viewers will be able to admire the landscapes of Norway, New Zealand, Canada, Switzerland, Wales and Spain.
